name: Bay Area Speedcubin' 30 2022

venue.name: Dwinelle 155
venue.details: Room inside the ground floor of Dwinelle Hall.

information:
Big Cubes + Blindfolded Events only **(no 3x3x3 Cube)**.

The main event is 3x3x3 Blindfolded.

* Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors.
* Competitors may only bring one guest maximum.
* Competitors **must** fill out [this form](https://forms.gle/aFCgCthsf9oxyJoT8) to have their registration accepted.
